quote: Author Rahul Saini has caught the pulse of his readers well. He uses metaphors to connect with the present generation.
Having mastered the young adult genre of writing, he blends rib-tickling comic tones to it.
Rahul Saini now spills all the dirty secrets of the city's publishing scene.
Rahul Saini's newest book is a behind-the-scene look at the (sometimes) murky world of book publishing and the writing process.
